title: Unified Ranking Across Retrieval Channels: A Large-Scale E-Commerce Approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.23530v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale e-commerce search and recommendation systems rely on multiple specialized retrieval channels to surface diverse products, each optimized for a distinct objective. A key challenge is merging candidates from these heterogeneous channels into a single ranked list under strict latency constraints while optimizing business KPIs such as user conversion. Static rank-fusion methods such as Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Weighted Interleaving use the same fusion behavior across queries, limiting their ability to adapt to context or model interactions among channel signals. We reformulate multi-channel fusion as a channel-aware learning-to-rank problem and propose a unified ranking model trained on a scalar, funnel-weighted graded-relevance label that combines clicks, add-to-carts, and purchases. translated_title: 统一跨检索通道的排序：一种大规模电商方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.23530v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大规模电商搜索与推荐系统依赖多个专门化的检索通道来呈现多样化的商品，每个通道都针对不同的目标进行优化。一个关键挑战是在严格的延迟约束下，将这些异构通道的候选商品合并为单一的排序列表，同时优化用户转化率等业务关键绩效指标（KPI）。诸如倒数排序融合（RRF）和加权交错等静态融合方法在所有查询中都使用相同的融合行为，限制了它们根据上下文进行调整以及建模通道信号之间交互的能力。我们将多通道融合重新表述为一个通道感知的学习排序问题，并提出一个统一的排序模型，该模型在一个结合了点击、加购和购买的标量、漏斗加权分级相关性标签上进行训练。该模型融合了通道特定的分数以及近期的聚合查询-商品行为，以捕捉近期的人群需求趋势（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文将电商大规模搜索中多通道检索结果的融合问题重新表述为通道感知的学习排序任务，提出了一种基于漏斗加权分级相关性标签（结合点击、加购与购买）训练的统一排序模型，以在严格延迟约束下更好地优化转化率等业务指标。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates multi-channel retrieval fusion in large-scale e-commerce as a channel-aware learning-to-rank problem, proposing a unified ranking model trained on funnel-weighted graded-relevance labels combining clicks, add-to-carts, and purchases to optimize business KPIs under strict latency constraints.
